title: Curious Urgency 44
author: bpatrick
body: I took advantage of the snow-day and made a comic.

comments.author: Ed Dale
comments.text: I love the feeling of paranoia and disorientation in Curious Urgency.

comments.author: cooper
comments.text: Gawd, I’ve felt exactly this paranoid at a party before. I think I’ma panic just reading it.
